propositions: Contributors and agents must fast-forward their own worktree (via `git fetch origin && git merge --ff-only origin/main`) after a change merges and before closing the ticket, so the merged `rebar-ticket:` commit is reachable from HEAD for the close precheck.

The close completion verifier (`_referencing_commit_exists`) calls `git log` over the repo root with `ref=HEAD` and fails if the merged commit is not reachable, because the shared main checkout was not advanced.
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md lack explicit guidance that contributors must fast-forward their own worktree only, and must never touch the shared main checkout (which may hold operator WIP).
Documentation edits (Markdown-only) to AGENTS.md close-discipline section and new CONTRIBUTING.md §2f subsection are sufficient to resolve the operator error; no code changes are required.
The pre-merge mechanism is correct; the root cause was missing human/agent-facing guidance, not a code defect.
